headlines.title_en: PBOC Governor Pan Gongsheng meets with heads of international financial institutions and finance ministers and central bank governors of relevant countries
headlines.summary_en: During the G20 Finance Ministers and Central Bank Governors Meeting from August 31 to September 1, 2026, PBOC Governor Pan Gongsheng met separately with IMF Managing Director Kristalina Georgieva, U.S. Treasury Secretary Bessent, Federal Reserve Chair Warsh, ECB President Lagarde, Bank of Canada Governor Macklem, Bank of Korea Governor Shin Hyun-song, Argentine Economy Minister Caputo, and Central Bank of Argentina Governor Bausili, exchanging views on the global economic situation and deepening bilateral financial cooperation.

headlines.title: 中国央行8月公开市场国债买卖净投放500亿元
headlines.summary: 中国央行公布2026年8月各项工具流动性投放情况，中央银行贷款方面，中期借贷便利（MLF）净回笼1000亿元，抵押补充贷款（PSL）净回笼521亿元，其他结构性货币政策工具净投放650亿元；公开市场业务方面，隔夜、7天期逆回购净回笼6415亿元，公开市场国债买卖净投放500亿元；中央国库现金管理净投放700亿元。

headlines.title_en: China's central bank net injects 50 billion yuan via government bond trading in open market in August
headlines.summary_en: China's central bank released its liquidity provision figures for various instruments in August 2026. For central bank loans: the Medium-term Lending Facility (MLF) saw a net withdrawal of 100 billion yuan, the Pledged Supplementary Lending (PSL) a net withdrawal of 52.1 billion yuan, and other structural monetary policy tools a net injection of 65 billion yuan. For open market operations: overnight and 7-day reverse repos saw a net withdrawal of 641.5 billion yuan, open market government bond trading saw a net injection of 50 billion yuan, and central bank treasury cash management saw a net injection of 70 billion yuan.

headlines.title: 潘功胜：中方从不刻意追求贸易顺差，坚持扩大内需、坚持高水平对外开
headlines.summary: 中国人民银行行长潘功胜出席二十国集团财长和央行行长会议。潘功胜指出，贸易摩擦和保护主义通过影响供应链、推升通胀、扰乱市场预期等因素拖累全球经济。各方应坚定维护多边主义，充分用好G20财金合作平台，强化宏观经济政策协同，携手应对全球性风险挑战。解决主权债务问题应坚持“共同行动、公平负担”原则。G20应发挥引领作用，确保各方在共同框架下有效落实“待遇可比”原则。经济增长是化解发展中国家债务问题、恢复债务可持续性的根本出路。

headlines.title_en: Pan Gongsheng: China never deliberately pursues trade surplus, insists on expanding domestic demand and high-level opening-up
headlines.summary_en: PBOC Governor Pan Gongsheng attended the G20 Finance Ministers and Central Bank Governors Meeting. Pan noted that trade frictions and protectionism weigh on the global economy by disrupting supply chains, fueling inflation, and unsettling market expectations. All parties should firmly uphold multilateralism, fully leverage the G20 financial cooperation platform, strengthen macroeconomic policy coordination, and jointly address global risks and challenges. Resolving sovereign debt issues should adhere to the principle of 'common action and fair burden-sharing.' The G20 should play a leading role in ensuring all parties effectively implement the principle of 'comparability of treatment' under the common framework. Economic growth is the fundamental way to resolve debt problems of developing countries and restore debt sustainability.

headlines.title_en: Pan Gongsheng: China has no need or intention to gain trade competitive advantage via currency depreciation
headlines.summary_en: [Pan Gongsheng: China has no need and no intention to gain trade competitive advantage through currency depreciation] From August 31 to September 1, PBOC Governor Pan Gongsheng said at the G20 Finance Ministers and Central Bank Governors Meeting that China implements a managed floating exchange rate system, adheres to the market's decisive role in exchange rate formation, while preventing market 'herd effects' and self-reinforcing irrational expectations. China has no need and no intention to gain trade competitive advantage through currency depreciation.

headlines.title: 美国商务部长进一步指责加拿大“搞砸贸易协议”
headlines.summary: 美商务部长霍华德 卢特尼克进一步指责加拿大，双方就究竟是谁在最后时刻搞砸贸易协议各执一词。卢特尼克表示，距离达成协议的截止时间仅剩数小时之际，加拿大谈判代表开始 “抛出各种离谱诉求”，这份协议本可以避免特朗普对加拿大商品征收 50% 关税生效。他指出，谈判破裂的周五，加拿大方面提出了中型及重型卡车相关诉求。卢特尼克称：“我对加拿大一位部长问道：‘你们是存心要把谈判搞崩吗？’对方回复我：‘我不便对此表态。’”“加拿大纯粹出于政治原因毁掉了这次谈判。” 他表示。卢特尼克同时也承认，美方或许也提出过部分临时诉求。

headlines.title_en: US Commerce Secretary further accuses Canada of 'sabotaging trade deal'
headlines.summary_en: U.S. Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick further criticized Canada, with both sides at odds over who derailed the trade deal at the last minute. Lutnick said that with only hours left before the deal deadline, Canadian negotiators began 'making all sorts of outrageous demands,' and the deal could have prevented Trump's 50% tariffs on Canadian goods from taking effect. He noted that on the Friday when negotiations collapsed, Canada raised demands related to medium- and heavy-duty trucks. Lutnick said: 'I asked a Canadian minister: Are you deliberately trying to derail the talks?' The reply was: 'I am not in a position to comment on that.' 'Canada destroyed the talks purely for political reasons,' he said. Lutnick also acknowledged that the U.S. side may have made some interim demands as well.

headlines.title: 日本一法院判决东电赔偿福岛核事故避难者
headlines.summary: 日本大阪地方法院2日就福岛第一核电站事故避难者诉讼案作出裁决，判令东京电力公司承担部分赔偿责任，但驳回了原告对日本政府的索偿要求。原告方不服判决，表示将提起上诉。2011年福岛核事故后，从灾区前往关西等地避难的79户家庭共221人向大阪地方法院提起诉讼，要求日本政府和东京电力公司赔偿共计29亿日元（约合1.2亿元人民币）。原告主张，日本政府对东京电力公司疏于监管，应承担相应责任；东京电力公司则因推迟实施海啸对策，导致发生事故，使避难者常年背井离乡、精神痛苦。大阪地方法院2日在判决时表示，日本政府即使对东京电力公司实施监管也难以避免事故发生，因此无需承担责

headlines.title_en: Japanese court orders TEPCO to compensate Fukushima nuclear accident evacuees
headlines.summary_en: Osaka District Court ruled on the 2nd in a lawsuit filed by evacuees following the Fukushima Daiichi nuclear plant accident, ordering Tokyo Electric Power Company (TEPCO) to bear partial compensation liability, but dismissing plaintiffs' claims against the Japanese government. Plaintiffs expressed dissatisfaction and said they would appeal. After the 2011 Fukushima nuclear accident, 79 households totaling 221 people who evacuated from disaster areas to Kansai and other regions filed suit at Osaka District Court, demanding compensation of 2.9 billion yen (about RMB 120 million) from the Japanese government and TEPCO. Plaintiffs argued that the government failed to properly supervise TEPCO and should bear responsibility; TEPCO, by delaying implementation of tsunami countermeasures, caused the accident, leaving evacuees displaced for years and in mental anguish. In its ruling on the 2nd, Osaka District Court stated that even if the government had supervised TEPCO, the accident would have been difficult to prevent, so it bears no liability.
